card.name: Leading digit of a percentage in parentheses
card.fires_on: The first digit of a percentage figure inside parentheses in adverse-reaction statistics, such as the 2 in (2.3%) or the 1 in Grade 3 (15%). It comes just before the decimal point or percent sign.

modes.label: Grade breakdown
modes.description: Digit starting a percentage after a Grade 2, 3 or 4 label in a list of adverse reaction rates.
modes.example: including Grade 3 (0.8%) and Grade 2 (<<1>>.2%) adverse reactions.

modes.label: Event incidence
modes.description: Digit starting the rate of a named event such as stroke or infarction.
modes.example: The incidence of myocardial infarction was 2.0%, and the incidence of stroke (CVA) was <<1>>.5%.

card.writes: It promotes closing punctuation such as parenthesis-period endings, which suggests the model is preparing to finish the bracketed figure and the sentence.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a percentage in a list of side-effect rates, where the bracket is about to close.
